scope: Reject atlas instances whose initial capture-plane squares cannot intersect any visible ray, before perspective quad expansion. Legacy and fragment programs unchanged.
rootCause: Conservative perspective halfSize divides by depth-extent.z. Near side-on directions, offscreen instances produce fullscreen quads; expensive atlas fragments reject those rays much later. Diagnostic yaw45 exposes33 fullscreen quads in Alkaid and28 in W26.
bound: Every accepted initial atlas projection lies in a square[-h,h]^2 at depth0. Its corner radius is sqrt(2)*h. Factor1.5 provides rounding margin; view transform row lengths form an enclosing AABB. Four projection side planes only; no near/far changes. This accounts for synthetic atlas coverage outside the physical sphere.

method.hardware: Native Chrome155, AMD Radeon Graphics / ANGLE D3D11,1280x720 DPR1, Yandex S3 assets, Vite dev server
method.frozen: Stop engine, clone actual instance matrices/world transforms and nontexture uniforms, preserve borrowed geometry/textures. Original independent vertex-main copy from b8d4d3d8 versus actual production shader. Render isolated L1 to RGBA32F+depth; compare HDR and sampled depth components numerically and as Uint32 bits.
method.timing: Six warmup pairs then32 adjacent baseline/production native GPU query pairs, followed by a second complete batch. Drain after each pair to bound queued work; both variants share the same frozen inputs. Timings cover L1 draw, not whole frame.
method.motion: 64 actual engine frames,4000km translation and360-degree camera turn. Per-draw elapsed queries tagged by frame and summed inside RenderPass; query overhead present; volumes and postprocessing excluded. No paired baseline motion run.

conclusions.remaining: Audit item16 remains open: Near/L0 and volume/reconstruction costs remain; L1 no longer dominates these measured motion paths.
